Game Description
Write your own legend in the Three Kingdoms! ‘Hero’s Ambition: Three Kingdoms’ is a single-player RPG where you take on the role of a hero in the tumultuous late Han and Three Kingdoms era to forge your own path. Play as a loyal general aiding a wise lord to unite the realm, carve out your own domain as a ruler, or roam as a free officer raising private troops to tip the scales of history. Forge sworn brotherhoods, fall in love, marry, and raise heirs. Grow your family, manage properties, or retreat into sacred mountains and great rivers to cultivate martial arts and eloquence alongside your kin. Drill elite legions, experience and rewrite history from diverse perspectives, weave grand diplomatic alliances, or sweep across the land with iron and blood until all under heaven bow before you.

Explore a meticulously crafted three-tier world spanning the strategic world map, bustling city interfaces, and intimate local scenes. From grand territorial conquests and military maneuvers to vibrant urban architecture and detailed life scenes and dramatic events, immerse yourself in an extraordinarily rich and dynamic Three Kingdoms world.

The game features over 20 starting scenarios, spanning pivotal historical milestones from ‘The Yellow Turban Rebellion’ at the era’s beginning to ‘The Battle of Xiling’ at its twilight.

It builds an expansive world featuring over 1,300 historical officers, brought to life with more than 2,000 full-body animated portraits. You can create your own officers before starting the game, while randomly generated officers will also continuously emerge across the Three Kingdoms as gameplay unfolds.

Game Description
The horns sound, the ravens gather. An empire is torn by civil war. Beyond its borders, new kingdoms rise. Gird on your sword, don your armour, summon your followers and ride forth to win glory on the battlefields of Calradia. Establish your hegemony and create a new world out of the ashes of the old.

Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord is the eagerly awaited sequel to the critically acclaimed medieval combat simulator and role-playing game, Mount & Blade: Warband.

Game Features

  • Create and develop a character that matches your play style as you explore, raid and conquer your way across a vast medieval sandbox where no two playthroughs are the same.
  • Raise armies, engage in politics, trade, craft weapons, recruit companions and manage your fiefdom as you attempt to establish your clan among the nobility of Calradia.
  • Command and fight alongside your troops in first- or third-person in huge real-time battles using Mount & Blade’s deep but intuitive skill-based directional combat system.
  • Put your combat prowess to the test against players from all over the world in multi-player PvP, including ranked matchmaking and casual game modes, or host your own server with the Mount & Blade II: Dedicated Server files.
  • Customise the game to experience an entirely different adventure using the Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord – Modding Kit and share your creations with others through Steam Workshop.

Backwards Compatibility

This repack IS slightly backwards compatible with my previous M&B2 repack. You can rehash fg-unused-videos.bin & fg-optional-bonus-content.bin to save up to 1.3 GB of traffic.
